question:
Select the correct spelling of the incorrectly spelt word in the given sentence.

The principal announced several curricullam changes for the upcoming year.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1** i.e. "curricular".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"curricullam"** is incorrectly spelled. The correct spelling is **"curricular"**.
 
• **"Curricullam"** does not exist in the English language. It seems to be a misspelling of "curriculum" or "curricular".
 
• The word **"curricular"** means something that is related to a school, college, or educational curriculum. (पाठ्यक्रम से संबंधित)
 
 
• **Example:** The school introduced new extracurricular and curricular activities this year.
 
 
 
• **"Curriculum"** refers to the subjects comprising a course of study in a school or college. (पाठ्यक्रम)
 
 
• **Example:** The curriculum includes courses in science, mathematics, and history.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1 i.e. "curricular".**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Option 2: curricural** (incorrect spelling) - This is an invalid word in English. (त्रुटिपूर्ण शब्द)
 
• **Option 3: currciular** (incorrect spelling) - This is also an invalid word and a misspelling of "curricular". (त्रुटिपूर्ण शब्द)
 
• **Option 4: curicullam** (incorrect spelling) - This is a misspelling of "curriculum" and is invalid in English. (त्रुटिपूर्ण शब्द)
